info.title: Mori Generation API
info.description: Shared Generation lifecycle for Create and version-scoped, non-destructive Mori Studio changes.

post.summary: Generate alternatives from an immutable source version

400.description: The command violates a scope or input invariant

404.description: The source version was not found

409.description: The idempotency key or source version state conflicts

422.description: The requested operation cannot be rendered from this source

get.summary: List playable candidate takes for a Project

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

200.description: Candidates ordered from newest to oldest

get.summary: Read a generation snapshot for refresh and recovery

post.summary: Create a new song generation in a Project

202.description: The new song generation was accepted

400.description: The request violates an input invariant

409.description: The idempotency key conflicts with an earlier command

422.description: The Project cannot accept a new generation

get.description: Returns a replayable Server-Sent Events stream. Send Last-Event-ID to resume after a disconnect; the event name is generation.progress and each data payload follows GenerationEventData.

schema.description: SSE frames with event: generation.progress and JSON data shaped as GenerationEventData.

202.description: The cancellation was accepted or already applied

409.description: The generation is already in a terminal state

ReferenceAssetRefs.description: Ready Storage Asset identities only; source_ref values are not accepted.
